purpose: Teach: 表象/場内/別館/採集/持ち出す/取り返し/備考/呼びかける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、君の表象、絶対、研究者として、本気で、磨いていけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — your research identity, your signature as a scholar. Polish it. Make it real. I'm asking you seriously.
lines.style: Steady, measured cadence. Weight on 「本気で」. Not harsh — the kind of conviction that comes from having seen what Ren can become. Leans slightly forward. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の場内、本気で、絶対、独自の発表、絶対、目指してまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'll pursue an original presentation at the conference. I'm truly grateful for this opportunity.
lines.style: Formal but genuine. Slight breathiness on the affirmation. Meets the intensity without matching it — respectful, not performing. Steady pulse of commitment underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の別館、本気で、絶対、活用、進めろ、本気で、君の研究、絶対、捗るからな、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Use the lab annex. Make full use of it. Your research will move faster there — I know you will.
lines.style: Practical and assured. Not a suggestion but a gift offered matter-of-factly. Slight warmth underneath the directiveness — this is support wearing the mask of instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ採集、本気で、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'll gather the data carefully and methodically. Thank you for everything you've provided.
lines.style: Quieter here. Acknowledging both the responsibility and the trust. Precise enunciation on 「丁寧に」. Respectful without stiffness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究データ、本気で、絶対、研究室外、絶対、持ち出すな、本気で、機密保持、徹底だ、本気で、頼んだぞ、本気で、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Research data stays in the lab. Complete confidentiality. Don't take anything outside. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Tone hardens fractionally — still composed but with an edge. This is where mercy ends and requirement begins. Brief pause after the instruction, letting it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。取り返しのつかない、本気で、絶対、ミス、避けるよう、本気で、絶対、慎重に、研究、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I understand. I'll move carefully, avoid any mistakes we can't undo. Thank you for trusting me with this.
lines.style: Solemn undertone. The words land with real weight — he's absorbing the seriousness. Slow, deliberate pacing. No rush to fill silence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の備考、本気で、絶対、丁寧に、書け、本気で、読み手、絶対、わかりやすく、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Write your notes carefully. Make them clear for anyone who reads them. That matters.
lines.style: Shifts back to mentor tone — less instruction, more investment. Slight emphasis on 「わかりやすく」. Almost gentle, the way someone speaks when they want something done right because it will last.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後輩に、本気で、絶対、勉強会、呼びかけるつもりです、本気で、知識、共有してまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to organize study sessions with the junior researchers and share what I learn. Thank you so much.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath the politeness. He's found the thread — not just receiving, but passing it forward. Slight lift at the end, like he's seen the bigger picture now. Genuine.
